text: Its office is dark, and its servers are off.

text: Tomorrow at eight, Aziz opens the mobile bank and logs in.

text: Does it work?

text: In Lesson 3, the three checks touched passports and phone numbers.

text: This lesson shows where those checks run, and the short list of places that heeyID may call.

text: The answer is yes, and that answer is the whole design.
prefix: The answer is yes, and that answer is the whole design.

text: heeyID runs inside the perimeter of the bank.
prefix: heeyID runs inside the perimeter of the bank.

text: The bank installs it on its own infrastructure, and the bank operates it.
prefix: The bank installs it on its own infrastructure, and the bank operates it.

text: One installation serves one bank, with all its apps.
prefix: One installation serves one bank, with all its apps.

text: A second bank gets a second installation, on its own infrastructure.
prefix: A second bank gets a second installation, on its own infrastructure.

text: Nothing in the installation calls the vendor.
prefix: Nothing in the installation calls the vendor.

text: There is no control plane at the vendor, and no data that goes home.
prefix: There is no control plane at the vendor, and no data that goes home.

text: The installation does not need the vendor to work, so the dark office changes nothing for Aziz.
prefix: The installation does not need the vendor to work, so the dark office changes nothing for Aziz.

text: I think this is the most useful promise a vendor can give a bank: at night, the vendor is not needed.
prefix: I think this is the most useful promise a vendor can give a bank: at night, the vendor is not needed.

text: The personal data stays in the bank, in the Republic of Uzbekistan, as the personal-data law says.

text: Now look at the edge of the perimeter.
prefix: Now look at the edge of the perimeter.

text: What may cross it?

text: The list is short, and the installation configuration names every host on it.

text: First, the services of the bank: the SMS service, the customer records, the antifraud system and the security monitoring.

text: Second, TAF, the antifraud service of the mobile operators.

text: Its agent already runs inside the bank network, so heeyID calls only the API of that agent.
prefix: Its agent already runs inside the bank network, so heeyID calls only the API of that agent.

text: Nobody installs anything for it.
prefix: Nobody installs anything for it.

text: Third, MyID, outside the perimeter.
prefix: Third, MyID, outside the perimeter.

text: heeyID calls it only from its MyID adapter, over a pinned connection, with a credential from the key store of the bank.
prefix: heeyID calls it only from its MyID adapter, over a pinned connection, with a credential from the key store of the bank.

text: And one more: the push service, which wakes up the app on Aziz's phone.

text: It is outside too, so a push carries only the type of the message and a reference.

text: It has no code, no text and no personal data.

text: The app then gets the text from heeyID, over its own session.

text: That is the whole list.

text: An egress proxy at the edge lets only these names out.

text: Inside the perimeter, the installation has zones of its own.

text: All traffic comes in through one edge.

text: Behind the edge are the application services: the two gateways, Keycloak and the workers.

text: Behind them is the data zone: Postgres, Valkey, Kafka and Vault.

text: The data zone accepts no connection from the edge.

text: A request must pass a gateway first.

text: Now the second kind of zone.

text: The bank runs heeyID two times: stage in its test zone, and production in its production zone.
